pins.name: Forest Herbal Land, charcoal-kiln spa (숲속한방랜드)
pins.desc: Bongwonsa-gil 75-7, Seodaemun-gu, near Sinchon, about 2.4 km north-east of Hongik University Station in a straight line. Not on either walk, so it is a separate pin. A jjimjilbang (Korean bathhouse) in the woods, and one of the best ways to warm up on a cold day. Reports say it has charcoal kilns outdoors, which is unusual for a city spa. Hours (per Naver, 2026-10-24): daily 06:30–22:00. Check Naver for prices and what to bring.
